arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Verify that different format strings produce equal FixedTzOffset objects
fmt = 'a {:ti} b'

result_0100 = parse.parse(fmt, 'a 1997-07-16T19:20+0100 b')
result_01_00 = parse.parse(fmt, 'a 1997-07-16T19:20+01:00 b')

tz_0100 = result_0100[0].tzinfo
tz_01_00 = result_01_00[0].tzinfo

print(f'tz +0100 == tz +01:00? {tz_0100 == tz_01_00}')
print(f'tz +0100._name: {tz_0100._name}')
print(f'tz +01:00._name: {tz_01_00._name}')
print(f'tz +0100._offset: {tz_0100._offset}')
print(f'tz +01:00._offset: {tz_01_00._offset}')

# Test with negative offsets
result_m530 = parse.parse(fmt, 'a 1997-07-16T19:20-0530 b')
result_m5_30 = parse.parse(fmt, 'a 1997-07-16T19:20-05:30 b')

tz_m530 = result_m530[0].tzinfo
tz_m5_30 = result_m5_30[0].tzinfo

print(f'\ntz -0530 == tz -05:30? {tz_m530 == tz_m5_30}')
print(f'tz -0530._name: {tz_m530._name}')
print(f'tz -05:30._name: {tz_m5_30._name}')
"
